name: La Jolla Covering Repository
license: No formal licence stated; a public research repository of covering designs.

credit.statement: Covering-design records come from the La Jolla Covering Repository, built and maintained by Daniel M. Gordon at the Center for Communications Research.
credit.requested_citation: Cite the La Jolla Covering Repository, D. M. Gordon, https://ljcr.dmgordon.org/cover.html

retrieval.method: Parse the published bound tables, then fetch each candidate cell's covering page for its stated lower and upper bounds.

redistribution.note: Records store parameters, the two bounds, and a quoted bound line. Record coverings are not redistributed.

caveats: Table entries are upper bounds from known constructions, so a cell is open when the stated lower bound is strictly smaller.
The lower bound is the source's claim and is not independently reproved here; it is only checked to be at least the Schonheim bound, which this repository recomputes.
Improving an upper bound narrows the gap but does not close the cell: the exact value stays unknown until the bounds meet.
